landing.eyebrow: AOEhub (Alpha Omega Education) — for homeschool, unschool, and school families alike
landing.h1:
Education isn't something you copy.
It's something you walk.
landing.subhead: A free home for the philosophy, the honest experience, and the curriculum behind education — shared by families who started the walk before you, for families just starting now.
landing.browsePost: and the Experience Board — no account needed to look around.
landing.signupPre: Want to download a file, post something, or leave a comment?
landing.signupStrong: Sign up or log in — it's free.
landing.pullquote: "Education is an atmosphere, a discipline, and a life."
landing.taglineSmall: The Experience Board and File Board are always free · Built by those who've walked this path, are walking it now, and are just starting.
landing.marketplaceNote: Heads-up: we plan to add a marketplace in a later update, where members can buy and sell. The Experience Board and File Board will stay free. We work hard to prevent scams, but we can't guarantee none will happen.
common.machineTranslated: This language is machine-translated and may contain mistakes.
landing.expTitle: Real stories, and the philosophy behind them
landing.expDesc: What worked, what didn't, and what they'd do differently — plus honest reflections on why we educate at all, from the Bible, Charlotte Mason <note>(a 19th-century educator known for her living-books, nature-study approach)</note>, Karl Witte <note>(a 19th-century writer known for his early-education philosophy)</note>, and everyone here who has their own thoughts to share. This isn't just the founders' philosophy — it's everybody's, filed under its own tag so it's easy to find.
landing.fileTitle: Free curriculum, books, cards, games, and printables
landing.fileDesc: Download, use, and remix anything — always at no cost, and always credited back to whoever made it first.
signin.title: Sign in to continue
signin.body: Browsing is always free. Downloading, posting, uploading, remixing, commenting, following, and reporting need an account.
